[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/n4iFaG9r/pioneer-generation-package#main-content) # Pioneer Generation Package - SupportGoWhere Pioneer Generation Package Share link Special recognition to our Pioneer Generation through a package that assures them of affordable healthcare. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Provides our Pioneer Generation with a special package that ensures affordable healthcare - Benefits include life-long monthly cash assistance and healthcare subsidies Expand all sections About this support Provides the following benefits to support healthcare for Pioneers: | MediSave Top-Ups | - Annual MediSave top-ups for life, ranging from $300 to $1,200 depending on birth cohort, to offset premiums for MediShield Life, ElderShield and CareShield Life.

- Additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 will be disbursed from 2021 to 2025 for older Pioneers (i.e. those aged 82 and above in 2021) with serious pre-existing conditions who are paying additional premiums. | | Additional Outpatient Care Subsidies | - Additional subsidies for outpatient care at polyclinics, public Specialist Outpatient Clinics and Community Health Assist Scheme clinics. | | Special MediShield Life Premium Subsidies | - Supports Pioneers in paying their MediShield Life premiums with special premium subsidies of up to 60%.

- Combined with the MediSave top-ups ($300 - $1,200), Pioneers born in 1934 or earlier will see their MediShield Life premiums fully covered, and Pioneers born from 1935 to 1949 will have about two-thirds of their MediShield Life premiums covered. | | Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme | - Grants life-long cash assistance of $100 each month for those needing permanent assistance with at least 3 out of 6 of the following Activities of Daily Living:

- Eating

- Bathing

- Dressing

- Transferring

- Toileting

- Walking or moving around | | \[Incentives have ceased\]
CareShield Life Additional Participation Incentives | - Provides participation incentives (totalling $3,000) to encourage Pioneers to join CareShield Life by 31 Dec 2024, in addition to any other premium subsidies seniors may receive. | If you would like [more details on the above benefits as well as other useful information about this Package, please refer here.](https://www.moh.gov.sg/healthcare-schemes-subsidies/pioneer-generation-package) Who is this for? - Singapore Citizen - Born on or before 31 December 1949 and acquired citizenship on or before 31 December 1986 - Eligible applicants have been notified in 2014 - You may check your eligibility by: - Using the LifeSG app to view your Pioneer Generation e-card; or - Logging in to the Singpass mobile app to view your eligibility status How to apply? - No application required - Eligible individuals will receive the benefits automatically - To apply for the Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme (PioneerDAS), visit [this site](https://www.aic.sg/financial-assistance/pioneer-generation-disability-assistance-scheme/) for more information Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.moh.gov.sg/healthcare-schemes-subsidies/pioneer-generation-package) * * * For general enquiries on Pioneer Generation eligibility, MediSave top-up, and MediShield Life Subsidy: [1800-222-2888](tel:1800-222-2888) For loss of Pioneer Generation Card, and other healthcare-related enquiries: [1800-650-6060](tel:1800-650-6060) Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. * * * [Submit an enquiry](mailto:contactus@pioneers.gov.sg) Scheme last updated 03 Oct 2025 Try our AI search
